review_scope: Read-only fast gate limited to the three qa-final1 defects plus a targeted regression scan. Unaffected rubric scores are inherited only where current source and validation preserve their evidence.

summary.judgment: All three qa-final1 defects are fixed. Sign-off remains blocked because the demo still emits unrounded floating-point SVG coordinates on SSR-visible line and circle attributes. qa-final2 live-observed the resulting server/client hydration mismatch and mobile issue overlay; this fast gate independently confirmed that the implicated source paths remain unchanged, but did not independently repeat the browser reproduction.

inputs_read: current lesson MDX, demo, component figures, raw SVG, and registries

targeted_source_checks.result: PASS 5/5 former-defect assertions; regression risk present

former_defect_verification.evidence: PaddingVsDataLab scopes all preset buttons with [&_button]:text-ink. demo-audit2 measured the six labels in both themes with 11.86:1 or better contrast.
The raw SVG switches from desktop-layout to mobile-layout at 420 px and uses 23-24 viewBox-unit load-bearing labels. qa-final2 measured 11.21-11.70 CSS px at 360 px.
RealDftConventionLedger and PaddingDurationResolution contain neither figure nor figcaption and both default exports return neutral div roots. qa-final2 live-counted zero nested figure elements.

regression_scan.evidence: PaddingVsDataLab rounds polyline path strings with toFixed(1), but still assigns raw sx/sy/desktopY results to line y2 and circle cy. qa-final2 recorded a live React hydration diff such as client 189.67238647809046 versus server 189.67238647809043 and a mobile Next issue overlay. The current fast-gate source still contains all four implicated raw attribute forms.
regression_scan.required_fix: Round or serialize every SSR-visible SVG coordinate consistently, then verify in a fresh mobile dev session that the console has no hydration warning or issue overlay.

inherited_evidence.qa_math: PASS 27/27 with 10 complete exercise-solution pairs and no issues; no reviewed mathematics or prose source changed during this gate.
inherited_evidence.rubric: All qa-final1 PASS and N-A items remain supported by the unchanged lesson evidence and passing validator/typecheck/lint. V9 advances from WEAK to PASS because its two defects are fixed. V10 advances from FAIL only to WEAK because usability is restored but deterministic hydration is not.

required_fixes.issue: Non-deterministic raw floating-point SVG coordinates cause hydration mismatch.
required_fixes.verification: Fresh 360 px light/dark dev reload: zero hydration warnings, no issue badge, then repeat the four-preset keyboard task.
